identity.label: Modern real-world setting
identity.summary: Default present-day world baseline for contemporary erotic-romantic roleplay, using moderate embedded density, concrete logistics, public/private pressure, technology, timing, money, and social consequence.

memory_routing: Store public incidents, screenshots, missed calls, private reveals, social fallout, obligations, and recurring logistics only when they affect future scenes.
Route enduring contemporary rules to World Book and live scene pressure to Scenario Book.

guardrails: Do not make every modern detail intrusive or dramatic.
Avoid encyclopedic worldbuilding and abstract setting mood.
Do not anthropomorphize rooms, silence, weather, cities, or the world.
Every world detail should affect intimacy, friction, continuity, progression, privacy, timing, reputation, or consequence.
